0.name: TEXT_CTSERKKUGANEREPLICA_00506_STAELHUNDR_000_000
0.description: Never dreamed I'd get to see this side of the world before I started working for the company. Or after, for that matter. Fate's a funny thing, eh?

1.name: TEXT_CTSERKKUGANEREPLICA_00506_MENU_000_000
1.description: What would you like to do?

6.name: TEXT_CTSERKKUGANEREPLICA_00506_STAELHUNDR_000_010
6.description: Hancock called for all sorts to come and join in the expedition. Plenty of work regardless of your background, he said. So here I am.

7.name: TEXT_CTSERKKUGANEREPLICA_00506_STAELHUNDR_000_011
7.description: I'm a smith by trade─far from the best, but skilled enough to replicate Gerolt's works. If that sort of thing interests you, then let me know. I could use the practice!
